html.body: Date: 2025-04-09 REMARKSThe claims are being amended to correct minor grammatical errors in claims 21, 24, and 43. No new matter enters by way of the present amendment. Entry of the amendments and consideration of the following remarks is respectfully requested.I. Interview Summary On February 26, 2025, Applicant's representative Alyson H. Nickols participated in a telephonic conference interview with the Examiner, Steven G. Sanghera. Applicant thanks the Examiner for the interview.During the interview, the parties discussed amendments to claim 21 proposed by the Examiner in a call on February 14, 2025, and provided confirmation from the Applicant to make the proposed amendments to claim 21 as proposed by the Examiner. That amendment is written in an Examiner's Amendment presented in the Notice of Allowance mailed March 17, 2025.Applicant thanks the Examiner for issuing the Examiner-Initiated Interview Summary ("Summary") mailed on March 17, 2025. Applicant acknowledges that the interview summary generally reflects the substance of the interview.Applicant again thanks the Examiner for their courtesy and time in conducting the interview, and the guidance provided.II. Comments on Statement of Reasons for Allowance The Examiner made characterizations and assertions about the claims and prior art of record in the Notice of Allowance dated March 17, 2025. Although Applicant agrees with the Examiner's ultimate conclusion that the present claim set is patentable, Applicant does not necessarily agree with each or every characterization and assertion contained in the Notice of Allowance dated March 17, 2025. Unless expressly noted otherwise, Applicant declines to subscribe to any statement or characterization contained in the Notice of Allowance dated March 17, 2025.The Examiner is encouraged to contact the undersigned at (202) 942-5843 should any additional information be necessary.Respectfully submitted, /Xiaoli Weng/ David R.
